rows.desktop_responsibility: Settle an optional Remote Computer target without invalidating an otherwise valid account session: success returns ready with no cleanup; a definite target-registration failure runs target cleanup and returns unavailable; cleanup failure remains fail-closed.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: A Remote Computer outage or failed registration does not sign the user out or poison the valid account session, while failed target credentials/resources are cleaned instead of lingering.
rows.ios_platform_delta: iOS folds this helper into the canonical RemoteComputerAgentBoxOwner rather than creating a separate product helper. Definite ensure failures release only the optional agent target with trigger ensure-unavailable; deadline episodes preserve the existing late-success fencing and therefore do not prematurely release a target that may still settle.
rows.production_evidence: RemoteComputerAgentBoxOwner.performEnsure keeps account-scoped owner state alive, generation-fences stale completions, and on non-timeout ensure failure invokes the canonical RemoteComputerAgentBoxSourcing.release for that agent. Cleanup failure replaces the original ensure error as the visible fail-closed error, matching Desktop helper semantics.
